items.text: Bills ruled out DJ Moore (shoulder/stinger) after hard landing; X-rays, questionable then OUT mid-game TNF vs Lions.
items.implication: Other Bills WRs (if any) or TE/RB receiving bump short-term

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (ribs); unlikely available Sunday vs Raiders. Brock Bowers also DNP again post knee surgery, no practice since.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs ribs; Bowers post-surgery no practice
items.implication: Johnston/others WR upside; Bowers TE risk, handcuff or pivot needed
items.opportunity: McConkey absence expands Johnston routes/targets; Bowers snaps to Mayer or others

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday, second straight missed practice. Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist fracture) on IR. If Flowers OUT, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs for hamstring; Lane already IR
items.implication: Bateman primary beneficiary for targets/snaps; Flowers flex risk
items.opportunity: WR depth thin; Bateman flex upside if Flowers sits

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins injured hamstring at Wednesday practice; doctors don't believe serious but Week 2 status vs Bengals in jeopardy. DNP Thursday after limited Wednesday. History of hamstring issues including 5-game IR stint in 2024.
items.why: Hamstring strain (Grade 1 reported); DNP Thursday; MRI results pending full clarity
items.implication: High-end WR2 risk; if OUT, boosts Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel and Schultz TE upside
items.opportunity: Routes: Collins 37/42 dropbacks W1; backups already high route shares

items.text: Dak Prescott on Week 2 LOVE list despite soft W1. Home vs WAS (torched for 14.5 YPC/3 TDs W1); top-5 implied total 27 in high-total game.
items.why: Matchup smash + home splits + implied total

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson ready to go after ankle; unclear snap share vs Rhamondre Stevenson. Timing perfect: Pats desperate for explosives with AJ Brown on IR; strong matchups ahead (PIT/JAX/BUF etc pre-bye).
items.why: Full practice/ready comments; Brown IR creates need for playmakers
items.implication: Henderson committee/RB2 upside in good schedule; monitor split
items.opportunity: Explosive role potential; goal-line/third-down TBD vs Stevenson

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow limited second straight day (back). Expects to play but monitor.
items.implication: QB1 with risk; Chase/Higgins volume if limited mobility

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: Utilization Score 99 W1 (tied Bijan lead). 19% target share recent; 25+ touches 3/4 recent. Overreaction to injury scare possible.
Kenneth Walker LOVE: 24% target share (team lead) W1 Chiefs debut, 74% snaps/21-of-24 RB touches thru 3Q. RB1 overall range of outcomes. Vs IND (gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry).
items.why: Elite target share + snap/touch monopoly + soft matchup
items.implication: Must-start RB1; massive season potential if healthy
items.opportunity: 24% tgts + high snap share; red-zone/receiving work

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE bounceback: 27% target share + 13.7 aDOT (3 deep) W1. Vs TEN (85% catch rate/16 YPR allowed; 6th-most PPG to WRs).
items.why: Strong W1 usage + soft secondary matchup

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: Career-high 26% target share W1, out-routed Gainwell by 8, all RB RZ touches. Vs CLE (121 rush yds/4.8 YPC allowed).
Justin Jefferson LOVE: 37% target share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG avg in 6 career Wentz games. Bears D allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
items.why: Elite share + historical Wentz chemistry + matchup

items.text: Dalton Kincaid LOVE: 69% routes (career high last yr) + 77% snaps W1 (highest since 2024). Efficient per-target; DET allowed 27 to TEs W1.
Colston Loveland 89% routes W1 (TE high); 0 pts/2 tgts but missed EZ throws. Buy if owners panic-sell after Bears 59-pt game.
items.why: Elite route rate despite low production/variance
